core_obligations: Reduce the lemma to algebra by fixing geometric points and using the two flatness-at-a-point characterizations (proof lines 6481-6488).
Derive assertion (1) from transitivity of flatness (proof lines 6489-6490).
Show that condition (2)(b) makes the fibre of the stalk nonzero modulo the maximal ideal, so that (2) is a special case of (3) via the faithfully flat criterion (proof lines 6491-6497).
Derive assertion (3) from the permanence of flatness (proof lines 6498-6499).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with three assertions on a quasi-coherent F on X over Y over Z: flatness of F at x over Y plus flatness of Y at y over Z implies flatness of F at x over Z; conversely, if F is flat at x over both Y and Z and the fibre x^*F is nonzero, then Y is flat at y over Z; and the same conclusion holds if the stalk F_xbar is faithfully flat over O_{Y,ybar} (source lines 6456-6478). The proof reduces the whole lemma to algebra through the etale local ring characterizations of flatness, notes that condition (2)(b) makes the stalk nonzero modulo the maximal ideal so that (2) becomes a special case of (3) by the faithfully-flat criterion, and then applies transitivity and permanence statements for flat modules over local rings.
